title: Torture Princess: Fremd Torturchen
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: A teenager, Kaito, is killed and summoned to another world by Elisabeth Le Fanu, the 'Torture Princess', who makes him her butler. Elisabeth, herself condemned for atrocities, must hunt fourteen ranked demons and their contractors before her own execution. A 3-volume dark fantasy manga adapting a light novel.
life_message: Even a condemned sinner can serve others by facing worse evils, and two damaged people can come to depend on each other.
